items.q: Match each odour with its condition — 1) Cabbage-like / rancid butter 2) Cat urine 3) Swimming pool … A) Hawkinsinuria B) Tyrosinemia type 1 C) Multiple carboxylase deficiency (MCD)
items.exp: Cabbage-like/rancid butter – tyrosinemia type 1; cat urine – MCD; swimming pool – hawkinsinuria. (Book p741)

items.q: Match each odour with its condition — 1) Fish urine 2) Sulfurous 3) Sweet … A) Beta ketothiolase deficiency B) Trimethylaminuria C) Cystinuria
items.exp: Fish urine – trimethylaminuria; sulfurous – cystinuria; sweet – beta ketothiolase deficiency. (Book p741)

items.q: All of the following odour-disease pairs are as printed EXCEPT:
items.exp: Acid smell belongs to methyl malonic acidemia; cystinuria gives a sulfurous odour. (Book p741)

items.q: Which odour statement is TRUE as per the table?
